name: Tsukushite Agechau
source:
Main character is hooligan who spends school days fighting and now is hospitalized due to a minor incident. A cute girl visits him there. 
Other girls get jealous and a fierce girl battle for the hero begins. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个混混，学生时代总在打架，因小事故住进医院。一名可爱的女孩前来探望。其他女孩因此吃醋，一场围绕主人公展开的激烈女孩大战开始了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
